scope: P2 exploratory EGO planning and shutdown diagnosis with live D435i, VINS, localization adapter, depth gate, mapping adapter, and plan_env. No PX4, trajectory server, controller, or control publisher was launched.
qualification: partial development evidence only; P2/P4 and GOAL A-H remain in progress

diagnosis.launch_mode: flight_type=2 (upstream preset target default), waypoint_num=1, point0=(0,0,0)
diagnosis.assessment: The measured initial VIO pose was within the planner close-to-goal guard of the default preset waypoint. The early repeated first-trajectory failures are explained by this degenerate test goal. Later optimizer failures seen after motion remain unexplained; the manual-goal test below is one successful planning observation, not a stability result.

manual_goal_run.interpretation: The planner generated one B-spline for a nonzero manual goal. EGO returned to WAIT_TARGET after its trajectory-duration logic elapsed; no trajectory follower or vehicle was present, so this does not mean the goal was reached. The upstream waypointCallback currently ignores input z and yaw and sets target z to 1.0 m.

shutdown_patch.behavior: The synchronous startup wait for EXEC_TRAJ now observes rclcpp::ok() and returns after shutdown; main skips spin when the ROS context was already shut down.

build.command: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source artifacts/runs/p2-map-input-build-20261016-01/install/setup.bash && source artifacts/runs/p2-ego-odom-wire-20261016-03/install/setup.bash && colcon --log-base artifacts/runs/p2-ego-shutdown-20261016-10/colcon-log build --base-paths src/vendor/ego_planner/planner --packages-select ego_planner --build-base artifacts/runs/p2-ego-shutdown-20261016-10/build --install-base artifacts/runs/p2-ego-shutdown-20261016-10/install --event-handlers console_direct+
build.scope_limit: Only ego_planner was rebuilt; dependency packages were resolved from the existing Jazzy install.

runtime_test.signal: SIGINT sent to EGO launch process group during repeated close-to-goal failures
runtime_test.harness_limit: The subsequent 5-second mapping probe recorded valid localization, depth, odometry, and paired inputs but no occupied points in this static scene. Its map-output check returned nonzero, so the shell run exited 1 although the EGO SIGINT shutdown check passed. This run is not a map or planner acceptance test. The original test script also omitted its sensor launch PID from final cleanup; that residual sensor group was found and stopped during the next test setup.
runtime_test.residual_process_cleanup: The test script cleared its launch_pids array after stopping EGO, leaving the separate sensor launch group active. A later process audit found it; the sensor group was then stopped, and no active test processes remained. This does not change the EGO process exit result but limits the original harness cleanup claim.

limitations: One manual-goal planning run and one shutdown run do not establish repeatability or formal acceptance.
No goal execution, actual position/yaw arrival, collision clearance, obstacle course, or PX4 behavior was tested.
The sequential-start close-to-goal retry remains when the configured goal is within 0.2 m; production launch must provide a validated goal and finite caller-visible failure behavior.
Controlled depth-stale, epoch reset, clock regression, map snapshot readback, and multi-scene geometry remain untested.
